title: Flowers of Crystal
build: TOSEC disc, Flowers of Crystal (1984)(4Mat).ssd (SHA-256 0f591a69...57d0), a 40-track DFS disc of eight BBC BASIC II programs and four files of machine code; each program analysed as CHAIN loads it at &1900, the two adventures' machine code where their sound programs load it

credits.role: the author (the adventures' REMs, line 4; the Complete BBC Micro Games Archive; the story book)

tools.emulator: jsbeeb 2.4.0 (npm), in the kit's server (kit/bbc/jsbeeb_server.mjs), BBC B with 8271 and DFS 1.20; check-emulator 33 passed, 0 failed, on 24 October 2026
tools.disassembler: regenerator2000 0.9.20, one session for each part, the programs typed as BBC BASIC (kit/bbc/basic.py)
tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64, a hosted cloud session with no display

accuracy.note: 60 of 350 comments, from every part in proportion; five wrong in a detail and one doubtful, which was wrong too; all six corrected, with the comments that said the same
